summary: StudentPRPreferences manages student pre-registration preferences for placements, including adding, updating, deleting preferences, and gathering statistics about available and new placements, with robust business rules and exception handling.
purpose: To allow students (through system interfaces) to specify, modify, and manage their placement preferences, enforce maximum allowed preferences, and prevent duplicate selections. Also, to track statistics relevant to placements such as availability and new opportunities since last login.

workflows.name: Add Student Preference
steps: If SQL error occurred, check error type
If maximum preferences exceeded, replace error message with localized resource
If duplicate destination detected, replace error message with localized resource

workflows.name: Update Student Preference
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, Ranking, AnyDestInSite, AnySiteDestInService

business_rules: Number of preferences for a student cannot exceed maximum allowed
conditions: If SQL error occurs, examine and handle specific error types
system_behavior: Replaces system error messages with user-friendly, localized resource strings when maximum is exceeded or duplicate destinations are added
dependencies: SQL stored procedures: StudentPRPReferencesAdd, StudentPRPReferencesUpdate, StudentPRPReferencesDelete, StudentPRPReferenceStats
